tagline: A quick batter of maida and semolina with an egg poured on top, cooked under a lid on a low flame.

golpo.title: No kneading, no rolling
golpo.body: This is the busy-morning ডিম পরোটা: no dough to knead, no paratha to roll. A loose batter of maida and semolina with onion, green chilli and coriander is poured onto the tawa like a thick pancake, beaten egg goes over the top, and a lid does the rest. It's soft and eggy on top, golden and slightly crisp underneath, and ready before the tea is.

ingredients.item_en: Salt, for the batter and the eggs

steps.action_bn: ময়দা, সুজি আর নুন অল্প অল্প জল দিয়ে মিশিয়ে মসৃণ ব্যাটার বানাও। পেঁয়াজ, কাঁচা লঙ্কা আর ধনেপাতা দিয়ে ভালো করে মেশাও। দশ মিনিট রেখে দাও।
steps.action_en: Mix the maida, sooji and a little salt with water, adding it gradually, to make a smooth batter. Add the onion, green chillies and coriander leaves, and mix well. Let it rest for 10 minutes.
steps.maa_says: ব্যাটার যেন দলা না পাকায়, অল্প অল্প জল দিয়ে মেশাও।

chemistry.title: Why semolina, and why the rest
chemistry.explanation: In a runny batter, there's so much water that the flour's gluten never builds the strong, stretchy network a kneaded dough has, so the porota stays tender rather than chewy. Sooji is coarse, so it gives a pleasant grainy bite and a crisper base. The ten-minute rest lets the semolina soak up water and soften; added straight away, it stays gritty. Adding water a little at a time keeps lumps from forming.

steps.action_bn: আলাদা বাটিতে ডিম অল্প নুন দিয়ে ফেটিয়ে রাখো।
steps.action_en: In a separate bowl, beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and keep them ready.
steps.maa_says: ডিমে আগে নুন দিয়ে ফেটিয়ে রাখলে নরম হয়।

chemistry.title: Salt the egg early
chemistry.explanation: Salt mixed into beaten egg a little while before cooking loosens the proteins, so they set more gently and the egg stays soft and tender instead of turning rubbery. The same trick makes a softer omelette or bhurji.

steps.action_bn: চাটু গরম করে ব্রাশ দিয়ে অল্প তেল মাখাও। ব্যাটার ঢেলে সমান করে ছড়িয়ে দাও, তার ওপর ফেটানো ডিম ঢালো।
steps.action_en: Heat a tawa and brush it lightly with oil. Pour on a ladle of the batter and spread it evenly, then pour the beaten egg over the top.
steps.maa_says: ব্যাটার খুব পাতলা কোরো না, ডিমের ভার রাখতে হবে।

chemistry.title: A base for the egg
chemistry.explanation: The hot, oiled tawa starts setting the bottom of the batter at once, so it can hold the egg without the egg seeping through. A thin film of oil fills the tiny gaps between batter and metal, so heat reaches the whole base evenly and it browns without sticking.

steps.action_bn: ঢাকা দিয়ে কম আঁচে ৫–১০ মিনিট রাখো, যতক্ষণ না নিচটা পুরো সেদ্ধ হয়ে সোনালি হয় আর ডিম জমে যায়।
steps.action_en: Cover and cook on a low flame for 5–10 minutes, until the base is cooked through and golden and the egg on top has set.
steps.maa_says: আঁচ বাড়িও না, নিচটা পুড়ে যাবে আর ওপরটা কাঁচা থেকে যাবে।

chemistry.title: The lid cooks the top
chemistry.explanation: The tawa heats the porota only from below, so the egg on top would stay runny if it were left open. The lid traps steam rising from the batter, and that steam gently sets the egg at around 62–70 °C. Low heat gives the base time to cook right through while its underside browns through the Maillard reaction. On a high flame, the bottom would burn long before the top was done.

steps.action_bn: গরম গরম পরিবেশন করো, টমেটো সস বা কাসুন্দির সঙ্গে।
steps.action_en: Serve hot, with tomato ketchup or kasundi.
steps.maa_says: ঠান্ডা হলে শক্ত হয়ে যায়, তাই চাটু থেকে সোজা পাতে।

chemistry.title: Best straight off the tawa
chemistry.explanation: As it cools, the cooked starch in the batter slowly re-sets and steam escapes, so the soft porota firms up and the crisp base goes limp. Eat it within minutes. A sour, pungent kasundi or a sweet-sour ketchup cuts through the richness of the egg.

trivia: Mughlai porota is the elaborate cousin: egg and mince sealed inside a folded paratha and shallow-fried.
Semolina is coarsely milled durum wheat, the same grain that goes into pasta.
Kolkata's roadside stalls make a rolled-dough version of dim porota on tawas more than a metre wide.

quiz.question: Why does the batter rest for ten minutes?
options: So the semolina can soak up water and soften
quiz.explain: Coarse sooji needs time to hydrate, or it stays gritty.

quiz.question: What cooks the egg on top?
quiz.explain: The tawa only heats from below; the lid's steam sets the top.
